use_case_summary: NovaQuill is building an AI-first product assistant + document search layer for their mid-market customers. Primary workloads: embeddings-heavy vector search (periodic large ingestion bursts) and a multi-turn chat assistant embedded in the product UI. Priority: keep chat latency <150ms p50 for short responses and keep embedding unit cost low for nightly reindexes.
poc_summary: Two-week POC on Hosted API using curated open models + Redwood batching suggestions. Objectives: 1) validate p50/p95 latency for chat under realistic client-side batching; 2) measure token cost for nightly ingestion pipeline with different quantization profiles; 3) confirm prefix/KV cache hit rate improvements for repeated queries.
workshop_notes: Workshop output: recommended batching size ranges (dynamic batch 8-32 for chat, larger batches for offline embeddings), enable prefix caching for product FAQ flow, test int8 quantized candidate for embedding encoder to drop per-embedding cost ~20-30% vs fp16. Built a prototype unit-economics sheet (tokens per session, cache hit assumptions, expected savings). Action: run dedicated quantization A/B on POC and capture MRR sensitivity to unit cost.
